'''Chapter 371''' is called "The Admirable Captain T Bone".

==Cover Page==
[[Miss Goldenweek's "Operation: Meet Baroque Works"]], Vol. 10: "Today's Agenda: A Fun Little Fugitive Hunt".

In charge of scouring [[Kyuka Island]] for any at-large [[Baroque Works]] agents is none other than Captain [[Hina|"Black Cage" Hina]]. Her unit's biggest target: [[Galdino|Mr. 3]].

==Short Summary==
[[Roronoa Zoro]] defeats [[T Bone]].

==Long Summary==
The [[Rocketman]] continues on its way towards [[Enies Lobby]] while those onboard attempt to pass the time by discussing what they had just witnessed. They are then interrupted by [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] alerting them that there is a train up ahead however the others are instantly suspicious as it is way too soon for them to have caught up. It is revealed to be the last two cars of the [[Puffing Tom]] and since they cannot stop the train, Luffy uses '''Gomu Gomu no Rocket''' to propel himself towards the train to check and see if any allies are onboard. Once he lands, he signals to the Rocketman that no allies are onboard, just Government officials. As [[Zambai]] proposes that he instantly dismantles the train cars as they pass to avoid crashing, Luffy calls for Zoro and tells him to cut the cars, as they are in the way.

Obliging, [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] slices the cars in half using '''Nitoryu Iai: Rashomon''', shocking everyone onboard the Rocketman and the unharmed passengers of the train cars, allowing them to easily pass by without crashing. Noticing defeated [[Sea Kings]] up ahead, Zoro then realizes there is someone stronger close by, putting on his bandanna. Up ahead, [[T Bone]] continues to make his way back towards the Puffing Tom however notices that there is a [[Sea Train]] behind him meaning something has happened to the cars he left behind. As he prepares to attack, he is easily defeated by Zoro using '''Santoryu: Gyuki: Yuzume''' and the Rocketman continues ahead.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], sitting on top of the [[Rocketman]], informs the others that he can spot the detached cars of the [[Puffing Tom|train]] up ahead.
**Luffy uses '''Gomu Gomu no Rocket''' to propel himself towards the detached cars.
*Luffy signals to the others that their allies are not onboard the detached cars, asking [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] to cut them.
**Zoro uses a new technique, '''Nitoryu Iai: Rashomon''', to cut the cars in half, allowing the Rocketman to safely pass.
*The group pass by a bifurcated [[Sea King]], with Zoro, donning his headband, noting that [[T Bone|someone strong]] is up ahead.
*[[T Bone]] is seen running on the train tracks chasing after the [[Puffing Tom]].
*Zoro engages in an intense but very brief battle with T-Bone, easily defeating him with a new technique: '''Santoryu: Gyuki: Yuzume'''.
